comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 3a9441f and manuals/README.md. The note knobs are snapped MIDI note numbers 0 to 127 displayed as note names C0 to G10, and the interval knobs are 1 to 127 semitones. Both ranges are compared in volts with a half-step of slack added at each end. How far a glide has travelled is the second note's volume over the sum of the two volumes, so it is the player's own pressure that moves it, not a clock. The manual is written for a LinnStrument and describes the left and right knob of each pair; the code treats the pair symmetrically and only cares which is the larger.
